profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Meta Reality Labs
profile.summary: Embedded software engineer specializing in RTOS environments with a demonstrated history of successfully shipping both consumer electronics and industrial safety products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building neural interfaces for the next generation of input devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Developed MISRA compliant C software for a TI Hercules series safety processor running a safety- certified RTOS for a successfully launched 3D safeguarding system for industrial robots
- Designed a log manager with run-time changeable output to both serial and UDP multicast
- Designed a dual-channel safety inputs feedback algorithm with software validated output pulses and debounced input fault detection
- Developed a proprietary ARM stack unwinder prototype for evaluation

positions.title: Lead Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
- Built algorithms to control heating and cooling systems, collect real-time performance metrics, and manage over-the-air updates
 - Developed system architecture running on freeRTOS to maintain scheduling and synchronization between cooking functions and user inputs from our mobile app
 - Designed a software suite to automate manufacturing processes using bash scripts and unit/integration tests for hardware validation

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed firmware for a gesture recognition system using a matrix of capacitive touch sensors with LED response
 - Saved over $16k by analyzing and reworking PCBs that had been rejected due to faulty testing methods

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a C++ API for controlling lab instruments via GPIB and Agilent VISA for automating the engineering design verification process
 - Designed a GUI for the API using Windows Forms Application tools

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Learned about the Toyota Production System including concepts such as Kanban and Kaizen
 - Obvserved a Kanban system implemented on a production line for laparoscopic surgical device
